wish_topics.evidence_span: I'd want to make changing your mind cost less
If updating felt like a small, ordinary, even admirable thing, like "huh, I had that wrong, thanks," I think a lot of other problems would get easier
So people dig in, and wars, feuds, bad policies, and failed marriages get sustained long past the point where anyone could defend them on the merits
Disagreements would resolve faster, and people would be less easy to manipulate through their fear of backing down
people who, at some level, know they might be wrong but can't afford to say so
Being wrong feels like losing status, or betraying your group
make changing your mind cost less
I can say "you're right, I was mistaken" without much sting

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: Some stubbornness is valuable, since it's how people hold to principles under pressure. I'd want to keep that
I'm not sure those can be separated cleanly, which is why I'd call this a wish rather than a plan
